description: Header file defining classes, functions, and enums related to HTTP alternative services, including protocol validation, alternative service representation, and processing functions within the Chromium net/http module.

classes.name: AlternativeService
classes.description: Represents an alternative network service with protocol, host, and port.

classes.name: AlternativeServiceInfo
classes.description: Holds detailed information about an alternative service, including expiration and supported QUIC versions.

methods.name: HistogramAlternateProtocolUsage
methods.description: Logs usage histogram for alternate protocol usage.

methods.name: HistogramBrokenAlternateProtocolLocation
methods.description: Logs histogram for locations where alternate protocols are broken.

methods.name: IsAlternateProtocolValid
methods.description: Checks if a protocol is valid for alternate services.

methods.name: IsProtocolEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a protocol is enabled based on HTTP/2 and QUIC settings.

methods.name: AlternativeService::ToString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the alternative service.

methods.name: AlternativeServiceInfo::CreateHttp2AlternativeServiceInfo
methods.description: Creates an AlternativeServiceInfo instance for HTTP/2.

methods.name: AlternativeServiceInfo::CreateQuicAlternativeServiceInfo
methods.description: Creates an AlternativeServiceInfo instance for QUIC.

methods.name: AlternativeServiceInfo::ToString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the alternative service info.

methods.name: ProcessAlternativeServices
methods.description: Processes a list of alternative services into internal representations.
